# `Q-20-5` — Unrecognized Custom Node Type

> The pandoc-leg wire-format shim received a custom node type it does not
> recognize.

## What this means

Quarto's docx/pptx output goes through a Lua shim that translates Quarto's
internal "custom node" representation (theorems, callouts, cross-references,
and similar) into real pandoc AST nodes that pandoc's own Lua filters know
how to render. The shim received a custom node type its own vendored filter
tree has no entry for. Rather than failing the whole render, it dropped the
node's wrapper and passed its content through unchanged, without whatever
special formatting that type would normally get.

## Why this happens

- The version of Quarto that produced the document is newer than the
  vendored pandoc filter tree the shim ships with, and introduced a new
  custom node type in between.
- A third-party extension or filter produced a custom node type Quarto's
  own writer never emits.

## How to fix

Upgrade Quarto to a version whose pandoc-leg shim recognizes the type. If
the type comes from a third-party extension, check whether that extension
supports docx/pptx output at all.

## Related errors

- [`Q-20-6`](Q-20-6.qmd) — a different pandoc-leg fallback, for a callout
  whose crossref category is not registered rather than for an entirely
  unrecognized node type.
